newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) will announce a fresh anti-government agitation programme on Monday.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Saturday ordered immediate constitution of a task force to improve the management of the eight education boards.
Five commercial banks, two insurance companies and a leasing company have been granted permission to operate as merchant bank, in addition to their normal businesses.
The visiting Chinese vice-premier Lou Gan on Saturday said that his country would extend all-out assistance for the economic development of Bangladesh.
Some 420 tribals returned home on Saturday from refugee camps in the Indian state of Tripura on the second day of repatriation.
China will provide Bangladesh 30 million Yuan ($3.6 million) in soft loan to Bangladesh.
Commerce Minister Tofael Ahmed on Saturday said the government had taken measures to raise export earnings by exploring new markets.
A fresh policy is expected soon on the distribution of government's own land to landless farmers.
